name: Cooling mattress pad (Eight Sleep)

lead: Eight Sleep sells temperature-controlled bedding, notably the Pod mattress cover, which actively heats or cools the bed and tracks sleep. Sleep-optimization communities use it to hold a cool surface through the night for deeper, less broken sleep, better recovery and a more rested face.

The cover circulates temperature-controlled water through the bed and adjusts via an app. Reviewers have praised its temperature control, though a later review said similar features are available elsewhere for less. No clinical trial reviewed tests the product for appearance outcomes.

paras: Users fit the cover over the mattress and set a nightly temperature schedule in the app, usually cooler early in the night and warming toward morning, alongside other sleep habits.
Since February 2023 most functions require a subscription, and features depend on a cloud connection; a 2025 cloud outage left some units overheating.

angle.text: A temperature-controlled mattress cover holds your bed cool through the night, aiming for deeper, less broken sleep and better recovery that show up in your skin and face. Reviewers praise its temperature control.

lead: Eight Sleep is an American company founded in 2014 that sells temperature-controlled bedding, notably the Pod smart mattress cover, which actively heats or cools the bed.[1] It is discussed in sleep-optimization communities as a way to hold a cool sleeping surface.

Reviewers have praised its temperature control, though a later review said similar features are available elsewhere for less; since February 2023 most functions require a subscription.[1] No clinical trial reviewed here tests the product for appearance outcomes.
infobox: Roughly $180-288 per year for most features[1]

paras: Eight Sleep was founded in 2014 by Matteo Franceschetti, Massimo Andreasi Bassi, Andrea Ballarini and Alexandra Zatarain, and funded early projects through a 2015 crowdfunding campaign.[1] It later raised venture rounds, including a 2021 Series C, and acquired Span Health in 2022.[1]
The Pod provides variable temperature control and sleep tracking and integrates with Amazon Echo devices.[1]

On October 20, 2025, an Amazon Web Services outage left some mattresses overheating or unable to cool; the founder apologized and said an offline mode would be added.[1] An unofficial open-source project has offered offline operation since July 2025.[1]
No studies found in the material reviewed for this product.

timeline.event: Most Pod functions move behind a subscription.[1]
